_doc: Battle rule variants (plan area 2, items 780-793). Each variant only sets number keys that BattleModel reads at the start (BattleRules.VARIANT_KEYS); up to 3 combine, pairs in excludes cannot.

spark_poor.label: Spark Poor
spark_poor.text: Energy tops out at 6, and everyone starts with 6.

full_charge.label: Full Charge
full_charge.text: Everyone starts full, gains no Energy per turn, and resting gives 3.

swap_toll.label: Swap Toll
swap_toll.text: Every chosen swap costs the incoming Spirling 2 Energy.

glass_blades.label: Glass Blades
glass_blades.text: Every Spirling has half its Vigor.

tough_round.label: Tough Round
tough_round.text: Every Spirling has one and a half times its Vigor.

no_home_edge.label: No Home Edge
no_home_edge.text: Arts of a Spirling's own element get no bonus.

short_breath.label: Short Breath
short_breath.text: Every status ends after 2 turns at most.

strong_reactions.label: Strong Reactions
strong_reactions.text: Element reactions hit twice as hard beyond the normal.

late_end.label: Late End
late_end.text: From turn 15, every Spirling in front loses 1/8 of its Vigor each turn.
